caption:
The video captures a nighttime residential front yard dominated by a tall cone-shaped LED Christmas-tree display crowned by a glowing star, its pixelated surface showing two eyes with eyebrows and a pink nose above a green-and-yellow striped base. Behind it a single-story house carries a red illuminated sign, while several snowflake lights glow in the dark above the roofline. A parked car sits at left and a thin cable slants across the dark sky, with the camera holding steady.

The visible motion is mainly the animated on-tree face. The mouth of the pixel face, already animating on the first frame, cycles shape after shape. A closed grin alternates with a grin showing white teeth against a dark mouth and a grin with a red tongue protruding. Occasional wide-open dark O forms suggest a singing expression. The eyes, eyebrows, nose, star, striped base, house, red sign, parked car and snowflake lights appear fixed, making the animated mouth the clearest changing element.

The mouth animation continues without pause.
